name: hello_usb
title: HELLO on the unit: USB audio (M2c slice U): P10's stem T1 is HELLO's note and the master is on 9-10, the computer's tone (o3tone.py) is mixed into the master and is the take of INPUT = USB, the profile back to the boot P8, the card shared as a disk and ejected

steps.say: docs/M2C-PLAN.md section 7, slice U, the tester's rows. THE COMPUTER: the unit is the USB AUDIO device (the boot set, P8 with the return) and, later, a USB disk. A tester at the unit runs it; the runs that need the computer's own audio are SEMI-AUTOMATIC: o3hil has no step that plays audio, so start `python3 -I platform/mk66/tools/o3tone.py play` in a second terminal AFTER the scenario has said `usb profile 10 duplex` (it needs the unit's playback device, which only the duplex profiles have) and leave it running (300 s; restart it if it found no device). The disk part needs the unit's card in (--expect-volume XXXX-XXXX is optional) and removes only the files the session put there. Hands: nothing. Not covered here, and still the unit's: P11, P10 duplex behind a hub, `cpu` with the stems and the return on (read it in the log below).

expect: usb mode: AUDIO, profile 8, 8 OUT / 2 IN
steps.note: (the boot layout: nothing of slice U changed it)
(o3-sdk's boot map: the master on 7-8, 1-6 empty, as it always was)

steps.say: THE STEMS. `usb profile 10 duplex` re-enumerates (the console and the computer's audio device drop for about a second); P10's factory map is T1..T8 and the master. HELLO's synth is slot 1 (T1).

steps.expect: usb: (already presenting AUDIO with that layout|re-enumerating as \w+)

steps.note: (the device is presented again; the next step opens the console again)

expect: cpu: peaks and fault counters reset

steps.note: (C5 on the keyboard map, held for the captures below)
(o3audio.py record --channels 10 --channel 1 --not-silent: T1, HELLO's instrument post-fader)
(S2 is T2: no instrument on that slot)
(the master's left, on 9)
(the cost with P10's stems streaming: read the render and the max against the unstreamed baseline; the plan's estimate is 3.5-4 per cent of a block with the return on)
(no underrun with the capture stream running)
(an edit at run time: slot 2 is T1 too)
(S2 now carries HELLO's note)

steps.say: THE RETURN. RETURN LEVEL is 0 by default (the boot stays as verified): FIRST raise it by hand (Config, AUDIO, RETURN LEVEL 100 per cent, then Config to leave), THEN START o3tone.py (1 kHz, -12 dBFS): the tone is added to the master at RETURN LEVEL: the master's pitch is 1 kHz and the stem T1 has none of it. The next part sets it back to 0.

steps.note: (soft until a unit has run it: the master carries the computer's tone; needs o3tone.py running)
(T1 is silent: HELLO plays nothing and the stems never hear the return)
(the return stream's counters: no underrun, the fill steady)

steps.say: THE RETURN AS THE INPUT. By hand or by keys: Config, AUDIO, INPUT = USB, RETURN LEVEL 0 (the master then has none of it), then SAMPLE REC takes 1 s of the input (REC); the take's pitch is the tone's. The runner does the keys; the take is checked by looking at the screen and at `state` (the take's frames).

steps.note: (the cursor on INPUT)
INPUT: LINE ... RADIO, USB (the encoder stops at the last choice)
(RETURN LEVEL)
(to 0: two bursts)
(the master has no tone now; HELLO plays nothing)
(LEN 1 s)
(the take of the computer's tone, a second of it: the pitch is checked from the card below)

steps.say: BACK TO THE BOOT PROFILE. `usb profile 8 duplex`: the master on 7-8 again, 1-6 silent.

steps.note: (INPUT back to LINE)

steps.expect: usb: (already presenting AUDIO with that layout|re-enumerating as \w+)

steps.note: (the boot layout does not regress: the master on channel 7)
(and channels 1-6 are silent)

steps.say: THE CARD AS A DISK (Linux). `disk share ro` hands the card over read only: the port re-enumerates with a mass storage function; the computer mounts it under /media and the runner reads Apps/hello/ against the card; the computer's eject (udisksctl power-off) is the way back: the unit remounts the card and the layout returns. `state` says card=computer meanwhile and every save is refused.

steps.note: (the set changes, the computer configures the disk, the card flips)
(the card's own files, read twice and compared)
(the unit takes the card back and re-enumerates the layout it had)
(soft: the console is back once the set is back, a few seconds after the eject)

finally.note: (a pad left down by a failed run)
(a card still out is given back: refused with an error when it is not out, which is fine)
